question: Select k uniformly random items from a stream of unknown length using O(k) memory.
answer: I'd use reservoir sampling. Fill the reservoir with the first k items. For the i-th later item using one-based counting, choose a random integer from 1 to i; if it is at most k, replace that reservoir position. By induction, every seen item has probability k/i of being retained. Time is O(n), space O(k).
strengths: Provides the exact algorithm, probability rule, proof intuition, and complexity.
improvements: Could add one more concrete edge case or implementation detail.
feedback: Strong answer: correct, specific, and appropriately deep for the stated level.
